decisions.reason: No performance shortfall indicators; slack supports keeping this adjustable variant while it establishes.
Pegboard-back display appears to fill a niche; with no evidence of below-aspiration results, it is retained.
Standard quarter-pallet display is core to the firm's paper products and is kept.
Eighth-pallet format is a smaller option that may appeal to different customers; slack permits continued evaluation.
Although wood is outside the core paper business, it is kept because no shortfall is reported and slack allows exploration.
Media-product display is a targeted variant; without evidence of failure, it remains under evaluation.
